source_scope: Sivas historical NFS 1831-1844, broader Sivas eyalet NFS catalogue, modern Sivas 17-district settlement gazetteer, library family transcription index and centre 1844-45 TMT
quality_caveats: 156 single-name matches are candidates based on historic-kaza-limited present-day place names, not independent proof of the historical location.
819 original index rows are available in the separate searchable fihrist page, not all given unverified coordinates.
9 ambiguous matches and 654 unmatched originals are not forced onto the live map.
91 fuzzy spelling alternatives are held for manual review and are NOT live mapped.
402 NFS catalogue entries cover the historical Sivas eyalet. 117 other/mixed records cannot be treated as modern Sivas district villages.
59 TMT mahalle labels have not been given invented modern mahalle identities.
Only the 9 family cards with already-indexed family names were integrated. The other 62 PDF inventory entries require their actual content checked before extracting new families.
Legacy district-wise Sivas family index duplicate keys consolidated (Gemerek/Cepni, Imranli/Cukuryurt, Sarkisla/Akcasu, Yildizeli/Direkli Sarikaya).
Previous chat's separate Sivas(3).xlsx is not accessible in current file retrieval; only PDF master fihrist and comprehensive library inventory were accessed.
Live domain/browser rendering has not been independently visually verified.
